integrity: Classical lattice local central limit and conditional Gaussian methods furnish the infinite-population asymptotic proof; enumerations only check finite definitions. Full proofs and executable exact-arithmetic checks are included. No claim of independent certification or definitive literature priority.
scientific_limitations: Independent, uniform approval bits; three candidates and two seats; fixed second-seat weight; globally optimal Thiele rather than sequential greedy; neither deterministic tie breaking nor general culture is studied. The rational n^(-1/2) rate was known at the level of order of magnitude from prior integer-score theory, not an original order claim.
title: An arithmetic tie-rate dichotomy for three-candidate Thiele committee voting
